feature.description: Build target / executable name (legacy) or feature identifier

feature_scope.description: Optional scope of this package. domain=full feature image (ADAS/Navigation/Energy). sub_feature=component inside a domain that may become an independent image/version later.

sub_feature.description: Optional sub-feature key when feature_scope=sub_feature (e.g. realtime_route | voice_guidance | charging_recommend).

version.description: Semantic-ish version token without leading v (e.g. 2.0)

rollout_stage.description: Optional progressive rollout stage label (e.g. canary|beta|stable). Metadata only in this step.

rollout_group.description: Optional target group label for rollout planning (e.g. canary). Metadata only in this step.

rollout_order.description: Optional rollout sequence order (e.g. canary=1, beta=2, stable=3). Metadata only in this step.

promotion_required.description: Optional: requires explicit promotion step after shadow validation (metadata only).

rollout_policy.description: Optional free-form rollout policy object (thresholds, limits). Metadata only in this step.

image_digest.description: Optional immutable identifier (preferred: repo digest sha256:...; fallback: local image Id sha256:...). Auto-fill best-effort after docker build.

image_digest_source.description: Optional provenance for image_digest (e.g. repo_digest | image_id)

checksum_file.description: Checksum file path relative to package dir. NOTE: validates packaged artifact in image build context (e.g. copied executable), not the docker image itself.

checksum.description: Optional direct checksum value (if stored inline)

executable_name.description: Legacy: executable file name copied into the image (e.g. AdasFeature)

slot_role.description: Legacy role field retained for compatibility

status.description: Optional lifecycle status for tooling (e.g. registered/built/failed)

failure_reason.description: Optional failure reason when status indicates failure
